detection_threshold.status: provisional until both the flipped (inverted) and the scrambled nulls are complete
detection_threshold.kind: interim: GPD tail fit to the vetted inverted null (tuning stars passing the quality cut), post-vetting false-alarm rate 1/N_stars per sector; bootstrap CI

70.cameras: pooled: per-camera tails are too thin to fit (not published)

detection_threshold.borrowed_note: S* applies only to sectors with their own flipped null; others are not calibrated (no borrowing)

nulls.threshold_kind: interim GPD fit, vetted inverted null, tuning stars passing the quality cut (provisional)

threshold_by_null.note: S* is provisional until both nulls are complete; scramble = null when not yet run

gpd.u_rule: lowest u with k>=50 whose xi is within 1 bootstrap SE of xi at every higher u with k>=30

ffi_check_318707987.verdict: not testable: the target was not on science pixels in any requested FFI sector (42, 43); no independent recovery is possible from these sectors

cut_sensitivity.note: cut = star_quality_v1 (beta_max <= 3); no cut = every measured searched star; alpha = 1/N_stars of that population

s105_not_calibrated.quality_note: star quality not yet measured for S105; with-cut count pending

depth_audit.note: ratio = depth_box / depth (injections: implied depth_box = S*cdpp_d_rec/sqrt(n_tr_rec) over depth_rec); 'bad' = ratio > 2, < 0.5, or depth <= 0

survivors.note: The 23 sector-70 signals that survived the v0 deep checks, re-vetted with the v1 density and Gaia checks. S is the v1 statistic at the same peak. Interim S* = 11.1 (vetted inverted null). FAP = (k+1)/(N+1), k of N quality-passing tuning flipped light curves whose max S passes every check and reaches that S (post-vetting, partial null). Expected false alarms per sector at S from the GPD tail fit; 'marginal' when >= 0.1. No row is a detection or a confirmed planet.
